description.en: Stickybomb Rice lobs sticky rice bombs with timers at zombies.
description.zh: 糯米投弹手向僵尸投掷糯米定时炸弹。

chat.en: Stickybomb Rice has extreme confidence in bombs, rice, and the abstract concept of stickiness. She's published scholarly articles about all three.
chat.zh: 糯米投弹手在炸弹和糯米方面很有自信，以及对黏性的认识，并发表了三篇论文讨论了以上三个概念。

text.en: sticky rice sticks zombies to the ground
text.zh: 糯米把僵尸固定在原地

text.en: exploding sticky bombs trigger other sticky bombs
text.zh: 爆炸的糯米炸弹会引爆其他的糯米炸弹
